title: Trees & Range Structures

views.title: Binary Tree Patterns
views.intro: Most tree problems are one post-order that returns a value and optionally updates a global. Traversals, level order, LCA, build from traversals, serialization and tree dp share that skeleton.
table: Inorder / preorder / postorder iterative, Morris for O(1) space
Height, diameter, max path sum, balanced
Rob III, cameras: return a small state tuple per node

files.desc: Traversals, level order, diameter, max path sum, LCA, build, serialize, flatten, distance K, vertical order, rob III, cameras

pitfalls: Max path sum: return the best DOWNWARD gain (a path cannot fork upward), but update the answer with the bent path through the node.
Path Sum III: backtrack the prefix-sum map after both children return.
Recursion depth can hit 10^5 on a skewed tree; mention the iterative form.

views.title: Binary Search Trees
views.intro: Inorder of a BST is sorted; every BST question is either "use that" or "carry open bounds down". Deletion with two children replaces the node with its inorder successor.
table: Carry (lo, hi) bounds, never compare only to the parent
Iterative inorder, stop early; stack of the left spine
Two inversions in the inorder sequence

files.desc: Validate, search, insert, delete, kth smallest, LCA, sorted array to BST, recover, iterator, largest BST subtree, floor, Catalan count

pitfalls: Comparing a node only against its parent accepts invalid trees; carry bounds.
Recover BST: the first inversion marks `first = prev`, the last marks `second = cur`.
TreeMap gives floor/ceiling/first/last in O(log n) when a whole ordered structure is needed.

views.title: Tries
views.intro: Use a trie when many queries share prefixes: autocomplete, dictionary with wildcards, word search over a grid, and bitwise tries for maximum XOR.
table: 26-way children with end marker and pass count
DFS over children on a dot
Prune words as they are found
Maximum XOR pair, greedy bit by bit

files.desc: Trie, wildcard search, word search II, maximum XOR, replace words, suggested products

pitfalls: Word Search II: null out the stored word after finding it so duplicates are not reported.
Binary trie over 31 bits (not 32) for non-negative ints keeps the sign bit out of the way.

views.title: Range Queries
views.intro: Pick the lightest tool: prefix sums for static sums, a difference array for range add, Fenwick for point update plus prefix sum, a segment tree for any monoid, lazy propagation for range updates, a sparse table for static range min.
table: Static range sum, offline range add
Point update, prefix sum, inversion counting
Point update, range query (any associative op)

files.desc: Prefix, difference, 2D prefix, Fenwick, count smaller, inversions, segment tree, lazy tree, sparse table, skyline

pitfalls: Fenwick is 1-indexed internally; the template exposes a 0-indexed API.
Count-smaller problems: compress values to ranks first, then scan right to left.
Skyline: process starts before ends at equal x and keep a TreeMap multiset of heights.

calibration: SDE2 bar: all traversals recursive and iterative, level order, LCA, validate BST, kth smallest, build from traversals, serialize, trie insert/search.
SDE3 bar: max path sum, tree dp, BST delete, word search II, Fenwick tree for counting problems, segment tree for dynamic range queries, skyline.
Staff bar (for context): lazy propagation, persistent or offline-query tricks, choosing between Fenwick, segment tree and sparse table by update/query mix, Morris traversal for O(1) space.
